scenario: count_distinct over a bounded sliding window is exact (LSER.16.5.2): the distinct-value set over the ring buffer's raw samples. Asserting 10,20,10,30,40 — with a repeated 10 — the distinct cardinality the predicate sees crosses 3 once three DISTINCT values (10,20,30) have been absorbed; the duplicate 10 is not double-counted. Pin: a rule gated `count_distinct(r.val) >= 3` (the declared 5_s window, LSER.6.11.3) fires (action_log present).
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Int mutable

series Reading.val:
    count_distinct sliding 5_s

rule check:
    Reading r where count_distinct(r.val) >= 3
->
    log info "three distinct"
